content: Poo7uwaan De7ite
Simmi Xoossay siiqiyaa naanatuwaadan, A malatite.
Qassi Kiristtoosi nuuna siiqiide, bare huuphiyaa Xoossaw nashechchiyaa yarshshuwaadaaninne imotaa udiide immeeddawaadan, hinttekka siiquwan de7anaw bessee.
Shin Xoossaa naanaw bessiyaawaadan, hintte giddon woshummiyaawennee tunatethaa ubbay, woy miishshaa amottiyaawe mulekka sisettoppo.
Yeellayiyaawenne eeya haasayay woy pathenna qidhii hinttenttoo bessennawaa gidiyaa diraw, hintte matan ubbakka de7oppo; hintte hewaa ubbaa aggiide, Xoossaa galatanaw bessee.

Hawaa erite; ooninne woshummiyaawaa woy tunabaa oothiyaawaa, woy miishshaa amottiyaawaa gidooppe, Kiristtoosa kawutethaanne Xoossaa kawutethaa laattanaw danddayenna; miishshaa amottiyaawe eeqaw goyinniyaawaappe dummattenna.
Hinttena ooninne pathenna haasayan cimmoppo; ayissi gooppe, hawaa gaasuwan Xoossaa hanqquu azazettenna asaa bolla yaana.
Simmi hewaa mala asaanna zuppetoppite.
Ayissi gooppe, kase hintte dhumaani de7eeddita; shin Godaa bagganna ha77i poo7uwan de7iita; poo7uwan de7iya asaadan poo7uwan hamettite.
Ayissi gooppe, poo7uu lo77otethaa, xillotethaanne tumatethaa ubbaa ayifee.
Godaa nashechchiyaabay ayentto tamaarite.
Go77i bayinna dhumaa oosuwaa qonccissi bessiteppe attin aananna walakettoppite.
Unttunttu geeman oothiyaawe haray atto haasayiyaawekka pokkee.
Shin ubbabay poo7uwaa kesiyaa wode, qoncciyaan beettana; ayissi gooppe, qoncciyaan beettiyaa ubbabay poo7uwaa.
Hewaa diraw,
yaagee.
Simmi hintte waani de7intto akeekite; aadhdheedda eratethaanna de7iya asaadan de7iteppe attin, aadhdheedda eratethay bayinna asaadan de7oppite.
Wodii iita gidiyaa diraw, hintte wodiyaa hinttew danddayettowaadan lo77otethaw go77ettite.
Hewaa diraw, Goday koyyiyaawe ayentto akeekiteppe attin, eeya gidoppite.
Qassi hinttenan Geeshsha Ayyaanay qanxxennaan kumoppe attin, hinttena bayizziyaa woyiniyaa giyaa eessaa ushiide mathottoppite.
Mazimuriyaa yethaan, galatiidde yexxiyaawaaninne ayyaana yethaan ittuu ittuwaanna haasayite; qassi galatiyaa yethaaninne mazimuriyaa yexxiyaawaan hintte wozanaan Godaa galatiidde yexxite.
Nu Godaa Yesuusi Kiristtoosa sunthan, Aawuwaa Xoossaa ubbabaw ubba wode galatite.
Asinaabaanne Machchattibaa
Kiristtoosaw yayyiidde, ittuu ittoo moodettite.
Machchetoo, Godaw moodettiyaawaadan, hintte asinaw moodettite.
Ayissi gooppe, Kiristtoosi qassi woosa gollew huuphe gidiyaawaadan, asinaykka bare machchattiw huuphe; qassi Kiristtoosi bare huuphiyan, bare bollaa gidiyaa woosa golliyaa ashshiyaawaa.
Shin woosa golli Kiristtoosaw moodettiyaawaadan, machchetuu qassi barenttu asinaw ubbabaani moodettanaw bessee.
Asinatoo, Kiristtoosi woosa golliyaa siiqiide, bare huuphiyaa iziw immeeddawaadan, hinttekka hintte machchatuwaa siiqite.
I woosa golliyaa bare qaalaaninne haathaan meecci geeshshiide, Xoossaw dummayanaw hawaa ootheedda.
Kiristtoosi woosa golliyaa qitay woy deemuwaa cidhdhissiyaawe woy hewaa malatiyaawe bayinnaan, A kumentha bonchchuwaanna geeshshaanne borettennawaa udiide, bare huuphew shiishshanaw koyyeedda.
Simmi qassi asinay bare machchatto bare bollaadan siiqanaw bessee; bare machchatto siiqiyaawe barena siiqee.
Ayissi gooppe, bare bollaa ixxiyaa asay mulekka baawa; shin Kiristtoosi woosa golliyaa muziyaawaadaaninne naagiyaawaadan ooninne bare bollaa muzeenne naagee.
Ayissi gooppe, nuuni A bollaa dumma dumma asatethaa.
Xoossaa Maxaafay; “Hewaa diraw, attumawe bare aawuwaanne bare daayo aggiide, bare machchattina ittippe de7ana; unttunttu laa77uukka itti ashuwaa gidana” yaagee.
Ha xuuray wolqqaama tumatethaa; shin taani hawe Kiristtoosabaanne woosa golliyaabaa odee yaagay.
Gidooppekka, qassi asinay huuphiyan huuphiyan machchiyaa bare huuphiyaadan siiqanaw bessee; machchattakka bare asinaa bonchchanaw bessee.

footnotes.text: Hawe mazimuriyaa gidiidde ammaneedda asay xammaqettiyaa wode yexettiyaawaa.
